source_notes: Blank-ref fill supporting existing Status='proposed'. Barents Observer (May 2019) reports Novatek announced Ob/Obsky LNG as a future project; Gas Processing & LNG (Sept 2024) reports work suspended ('no active work is underway on either the Murmansk LNG and Ob LNG projects'), confirming it remains an unrealized proposal. Two independent non-GEM outlets. Note: a separate status_timeline qa flags the suspension for reviewer judgment.

Blank-ref fill supporting existing Operator='Novatek'. High North News states the project SPV is 'Ob LNG LLC (OOO Obsky SPG), a subsidiary of Novatek'; Offshore Energy reports Glavgosexpertiza approved 'Novatek's third LNG project, named Obsky LNG'; Argus attributes Obsky/Ob LNG to Novatek. Three independent non-GEM outlets; no separate non-Novatek operator named (Pre-FID).

Blank-ref fill supporting existing ProposalYear=2019. Barents Observer dates Novatek's announcement of the third Yamal LNG plant (Ob/Obsky LNG) to 21 May 2019; High North News independently confirms 'On May 21, Novatek announced its third major LNG plant'. Two independent non-GEM sources both date the proposal to 2019 -> upgraded to green.

Blank-ref fill supporting existing FIDYear=2023. Interfax (Feb 2023) reports CEO Mikhelson expected the Obsky LNG FID in Q2-Q3 2023; TASS independently reports Novatek 'plans to take an investment decision on the Obsky LNG project in Q2-Q3 2023'. This is the PLANNED FID year, not a taken FID: GEM FIDStatus='Pre-FID' and the project was later suspended (Sept 2024), so no FID was actually reached. Two independent non-GEM sources for the planned-2023 value; reviewer may prefer to recharacterize as planned-FID.
